trial_court: Special Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Kanpur Nagar, Case No. 2381 of 2008
case_name: Jitendra Pal @ Pappu And Others v. State Of U.P.And Another

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Jitendra Pal Singh @ Pappu, Tavindar Singh, Seva Singh, and Smt. Satnam Kaur — applicants
parties.respondent_defendant: State of U.P. and another — respondent no. 2

facts_of_case: Dispute between Jyoti Deep Kaur and her husband Manmeet Singh led to a confrontation where the applicants allegedly shot at respondent no. 2, who was accompanied by his son Gurdeep Singh.

legal_principles.principle: Courts should not compel parties to litigate against their own wishes.
legal_principles.held: Allowing such a prosecution to go on between one time close relatives will only add to discord rather than settle the dispute for which the courts exists.
cited_cases: B.S. Joshi and another versus State of Haryana and another: (2003) 4 SCC 675

legal_principles.principle: Courts should save precious time and avoid wastage of court resources.
legal_principles.held: To save the precious time of the court and harassment of the litigating parties prosecution of the applicants be quashed as trial will only increase bickering between the parties which will not be in consonance with interest of justice.

outcome.final_order: The proceeding of Criminal Case No. 2381 of 2008 is quashed.

use_for_drafting: drafting for quashing of criminal proceedings
drafting for stay of criminal proceedings
